'''Chen Jingxiong''' (16 October 1921 – 16 March 2022) was a Chinese engineer specializing in [[electromagnetism]] and [[Microwave|microwave technology]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].

== Biography ==
Chen was born in [[Zhenhai District|Zhenhai County]] (now Zhenhai District of [[Ningbo]]), [[Zhejiang]], on 16 October 1921. In 1943, he was accepted to [[Utopia University]], graduating in 1947 with a [[bachelor's degree]]. He went on to receive his [[master's degree]] in 1950 at [[Shanghai Jiao Tong University]].<ref name="ap">{{cite news|author1=Li Yuan ({{lang|zh|李苑}})|url=http://www.stdaily.com/index/kejixinwen/202203/1682205da5874a678fcc4c314669dc41.shtml |script-title=zh:中国工程院院士陈敬熊逝世，曾为中国导弹安上“锐利的眼睛” |work=stdaily.com |date=16 March 2022 |access-date=16 March 2022 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="bee">{{cite news|author1=Zhao Guangli ({{lang|zh|赵广立}})|url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2022/3/475760.shtm |script-title=zh:曾为中国初代导弹造“眼睛”，陈敬熊院士逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=16 March 2022 |access-date=16 March 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

In January 1950, he served in the [[Beijing Institute of Posts and Telecommunications]] for a year before joining the Institute of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications. He became deputy director of the 5th Research Institute of the [[Ministry of National Defense of the People's Republic of China|Ministry of Defense]] in January 1957 and deputy director of the No. 23 Institute of the 2nd Academy of the 7th Ministry of Machinery in January 1965. In January 1980, he moved to the [[Ministry of Aerospace Industry|2nd Research Institute of Aerospace Industry Corporation]].<ref name="ap"/><ref name="bee"/>

On 16 March 2022, Chen Jingxiong died from an illness in [[Beijing]], at the age of 100.<ref name="ap"/><ref name="bee"/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_17144878 |script-title=zh:痛别！陈敬熊院士逝世 |work=thepaper |date=16 March 2022 |access-date=16 March 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1985 State Technological Invention Award (First Class)
* 1995 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)
